title: pm-daily-scratchpad-2026-03-30
content:
Morning brain dump - M. Lee (30 Mar 2026)

Top goals for today:
- Finalize PRD edits for Hosted API v2 (focus: rollout & fallback policies) - target to send to Eng and Legal by EOD.
- Sync w/ Samir (infra) 11:00 to confirm Dedicated capacity numbers for canary.
- Prepare launch checklist for beta customers (internal review w/ Elena 15:30).
- Follow up with Growth about in-product onboarding copy (deferred from Friday).

Quick context reminders:
- PRD link is in linked artifacts; main open questions in PRD:
  * Default fallback model selection order (cost vs. latency). Need consensus from infra + research.
  * Telemetry/metrics: we asked SRE to expose per-route p50/p95 and cost-per-token; Samir to confirm ETA.
  * Legal: allowed logging retention & PII filtering for hosted customers - legal review queue (CON-legal-88).

TO-DO (prioritized)
[ ] Finish PRD section: rollout & rollback steps. Add exact criteria for canary -> prod (error rate threshold, latency SLO breaches, cost delta).
[ ] Add runbook snippet for automatic fallback (what to do if model variant unavailable). Draft fallback messaging for users (graceful degrade).
[ ] Compile beta invite list + initial prompts + example SDK calls (Elena to review).
[ ] Confirm Dedicated pool sizing with infra (Samir) and adjust quota language.
[ ] Ping growth for onboarding copy + CTA for trial credits.
[ ] Schedule 1:1 with Eng PM for fast-follow items next week.

Notes from 09:00 sync (product standup):
- Eng: serving-runtime team landed KV cache improvement; may reduce cold-start cost by ~8% (nice).
- Infra: Dedicated autoscaler still has race under high-churn; Samir is prioritizing fix before canary.
- SRE: adding tracing hooks for per-request route metadata - will help debugging during rollouts.
- Legal: still verifying KMS export controls for some regions; might push private-deploy timeline for APAC customers.

11:00 sync w/ Samir (notes):
- Confirmed Dedicated numbers: baseline 10 GPUs for beta, can burst to 20 with pre-warming. Need to update PRD capacity section.
- Autoscale race: mitigation plan is to throttle concurrent scale events for first 5m after spike; Samir to open infra ticket (JIRA-1427).
- Telemetry: p95 tracing ETA = next Tue; for now we can rely on aggregated metrics from console.

Action items from Samir meeting:
- Update PRD: change "burst to 50" -> "burst to 20" and call out pre-warming delay. (me)
- Add note: canary policy must include capacity fallback: route to hosted light model if Dedicated unavailable. (me + research)
- Samir to add infra ticket and link here (JIRA-1427).

15:30 review w/ Elena (prep notes):
- Walkthrough checklist items: docs, SDK examples, customer communications, support playbook, monitoring dashboards, cost-override controls.
- Need short status blurb (1-2 sentences) for internal launch email.
- Double-check FAQ: private vs dedicated vs hosted differences - this often confuses customers.

Launch checklist (beta) - draft
- Product: PRD final + rollouts doc (x)
- Engineering: canary deploy script, autoscale mitigation in place (x?)
- Infra: Dedicated pool provisioned (10 GPU baseline) (Samir)
- DevEx: SDK examples + quickstart (Elena)
- Docs: Beta docs page, API surface highlights, migration guide (me + docs)
- Support: playbook for failures, escalation path to Eng on-call (SRE)
- Growth/Marketing: invite email + in-product flows (Growth)
- Legal/Compliance: data retention + KMS confirmation (Legal)

Questions / unresolved:
- Should default fallback prefer lower-cost model or lower-latency model? (priority: get alignment today)
- Risk: if tracing not available at canary time, debugging could be slower - add explicit rollback guard?
- Do we open beta to existing Dedicated customers first or include new Hosted signups? Pros/cons outlined in PRD but need decision.

Notes to self (write-up reminders)
- When I send PRD for review: call out three asks explicitly (infra capacity confirmation, legal OK on logging, alignment on fallback policy).
- Keep the EOD email short: headline + 3 bullets + action owners.

Meeting follow-ups to schedule:
- Wed 10:30: Legal sync (15m) - confirm KMS/retention (Victor from Legal)
- Thu 09:00: Canary war room dry-run (Eng + SRE + Product)
- Fri 16:00: Beta kickoff retro (internal)

Random tidy-up notes (scratch):
- Remove stale "alpha-features" section from PRD (was used for internal experiments).
- Add sample metrics for rollout acceptance: p95 < 1200ms, error rate < 0.5%, cost delta < +15%.
- Draft fallback messaging: "We\u2019re experiencing temporary capacity constraints and are routing your request to a compatible model. You may notice slight differences in output; please contact support if this impacts your app."

End-of-day plan:
- 4p: send PRD out to reviewers (Eng leads, Samir, Victor legal, Elena) with clear asks.
- 5:30p: internal launch checklist finalization + send to stakeholders.

Stream-of-consciousness lines (keep brief):
- Might need to add small item to pricing: reserved capacity discount for beta customers? quick check with finance.
- Consider adding a short eval suite to monitor output quality drift vs fallback model (Research team).

---
Revision history:
- 2026-03-30 09:05 initial outline
- 2026-03-30 11:40 updated after infra sync
- 2026-03-30 15:45 updated after checklist review with Elena
